essence: The preparation requires new saffron together with yellow pigments.
The practitioner should hold an excellent sword in hand.
One should carefully take oil at night in a neem house using a hand-sprout.
One should anoint both feet at the root of butea and walnut trees with face-nectar.
The practitioner becomes the lord of speech directly, and this is no wonder.
